description: Bounded coupled CSR SpMV, symmetric Gauss-Seidel, one coarse-grid correction, and preconditioned CG profile.

source.title: High Performance Conjugate Gradient Benchmark (HPCG), Revision 3.1
source.algorithm_attribution: Fixed-count double-precision multigrid-preconditioned CG with a symmetric Gauss-Seidel smoother; bounded clean-room single-process profile
source.implementation_status: supplied matrix and right-hand side; one aggregate-pair coarse level; MPI, OpenMP, official scale classes, and runtime rules omitted

contract.profile: Apply a symmetric two-level V-cycle preconditioner inside preconditioned conjugate gradients.
contract.matrix_format: Zero-based CSR, strictly increasing unique columns in every row, nonzero entries, exact symmetry, and strictly diagonally dominant positive diagonal.
contract.coarse_transfer: Profile choice: P[i,k]=1 iff k=floor(i/2); the coarse matrix is P^T A P, with residual restriction P^T and correction prolongation P.
contract.symmetric_gauss_seidel: One forward Gauss-Seidel pre-sweep, exact coarse correction of the resulting residual, then one backward Gauss-Seidel post-sweep of the updated residual.
contract.pcg: Start x=0 and r=b; run at most cg_steps standard preconditioned-CG updates, stopping early when ||r||^2 <= ||b||^2 * 1e-28.
contract.output: n little-endian binary64 solution components followed by explicitly recomputed ||b-Ax||.

workspace.meaning: Maximum capacity of the packed binary64 solution and residual output buffer.
